correctness.rationale: For r≥2 nonempty parts of K_(n1,...,nr), a distance-preserving partial map is injective; f²=0 iff its domain is disjoint from its image. Distances are 2 between distinct same-part vertices and 1 across parts, so each active source part goes into exactly one target part and these target parts are pairwise distinct; conversely an injection θ on active part indices and independent within-target injective maps give all isometries. Choosing s_i domain vertices, s_i! labelings and binom(n_{θ(i)}−s_{θ(i)},s_i) free-image subsets gives the exact nonnegative rank polynomial with unique counting. For K_{a,b} the preserving and exchanging θ patterns give the displayed double sum with one subtracted empty-map overcount. Preserving feasibility 2i≤a,2j≤b gives max floor(a/2)+floor(b/2); swapping feasibility i+j≤min(a,b) gives min(a,b), hence sharp R(a,b), and restriction of a maximal map supplies every rank below. When a+b even the sole one-rank deficit occurs for odd unequal a,b. Independent direct partial-map enumeration reproduced six graph configurations including K3,5 coefficients (1,56,420,840,0) and K4,4 (1,56,456,1056,528). Finite enumeration is not the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Finite checks corroborate, but do not establish, the universal claim.

originality.rationale: Fernandes and Paulista (2022/2023) classify monoid structures for stars and cycles (a star K1,n is a subfamily; K2,2 is a 4-cycle); Fernandes (2023) studies wheels. Their papers focus on monoid generator rank, presentations, Green relations and total cardinality, which are different from element-rank polynomials of square-zero transformations. The cycle and wheel full PDFs were inspected anew, and wheel article states those goals explicitly. An authorized attempt to retrieve the star full paper after arXiv and lawful university OA routes failed reported VPN disconnected, so the star paper is a retained priority risk and NOT asserted whole-document noncovering. Complete-graph symmetric inverse monoid and small overlaps are classical. Broader partial-automorphism-of-equivalence-relation formulae might imply the result; best-of-knowledge PASS is limited to the unrestricted multipartite square-zero rank distribution and bipartite parity obstruction.
